title: Northbeam Renew Trade-In Quote Bands, Quote Life and Devices Covered
content:
Every quote written under Northbeam Renew Trade-In is written under one of the six Renew programmes, and the kinds of device the programme takes, the days the quote may be accepted for, the day that count runs from, the devices one agreement may cover and the band the quoted amount must sit inside are all the programme's own figures. This schedule carries them for every programme.

| Renew programme | Kinds of device the programme takes | Days a quote may be accepted for | What the count runs from | Devices one agreement may cover | Smallest quote the programme will write | Largest quote on one device |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | handsets, tablets and wearables | 2 | the day the quote was given in store | 1 | 5.00 USD | 600.00 USD |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | handsets, tablets, laptops, consoles and cameras | 21 | the day the quote was given online | 3 | 10.00 USD | 1400.00 USD |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | handsets and tablets bought with the guarantee | 30 | the day the quote was given | 1 | 50.00 USD | 900.00 USD |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | laptops and tablets bought with the guarantee | 30 | the day the quote was given | 1 | 75.00 USD | 1600.00 USD |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | business laptops, handsets and tablets on an asset list | 14 | the day the asset list was quoted | 60 | 25.00 USD | 2200.00 USD |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | business laptops, desktops, monitors and handsets in bulk | 45 | the day the refresh schedule was quoted | 500 | 15.00 USD | 2500.00 USD |

Notes to the schedule.

1. The days in the third column are the days a quote may be accepted for on that programme; the fourth column names what the programme counts them from.
2. The two trade-up programmes take only devices bought with the guarantee, and the two business programmes only devices standing on an asset list or a bulk refresh schedule.
3. The smallest and largest figures bound one quote: the smallest is the least the programme will write at all, and the largest is the most it will write on one device.

Hypothetical illustration of the band. A tablet described to the desk online is worth 1400.00 USD at the top of the Renew Mail In Appraisal range and 10.00 USD at the bottom, so a figure of 1400.00 USD sits at the edge of the band and is inside it, while a figure of 9.00 USD is below the smallest quote that programme writes. The same tablet described in store falls under the Renew Instant Store Quote band instead, whose top is 600.00 USD.
